claims.text: GPT-3.5 achieves a hallucination rate of 3.2% when trained on curated data.
GPT-3.5 exhibits a hallucination rate of 19.4% when trained on noisy data.
Intrinsic hallucinations occur when a model misinterprets or misrepresents the input text.
Extrinsic hallucinations occur when a model fabricates information that has no basis in fact.

evidence.description: GPT-3.5 had a hallucination rate of only 3.2% [14] when trained on curated data

Intrinsic hallucinations take place when the model makes a wrong interpretation or a wrong representation of the input, resulting in the output that includes details or claims not supported by the input text.
Extrinsic hallucinations, however, are the fabrication of information that has no basis in fact.

methodologies.name: Controlled Data Quality Empirical Evaluation
methodologies.description: Empirical analysis measuring LLM hallucination rates and factual consistency scores across varying levels of training data noise and curation.

limitations.text: Maintaining high data quality requires substantial financial, computational, and human investments in labeling, fact-checking, and bias removal.
Data scarcity in emerging scientific fields or rare medical conditions creates unavoidable knowledge gaps in LLM training corpora.
Strict reliance on structured, highly curated data can restrict model generalization and adaptability for open-ended or cross-disciplinary reasoning.
Knowledge cutoff dates in pretrained LLMs prevent them from accurately answering queries requiring real-time or recent information.

future_work.text: Develop scalable, AI-powered frameworks that automatically assess and score training datasets based on accuracy, consistency, and bias.
Implement adaptive data pipelines that continuously pull verified, domain-specific information from trusted sources.
Build robust, model-agnostic hallucination detection tools to flag ungrounded or speculative outputs in real time.
Establish standardized evaluation benchmarks across industries for systematic comparison of hallucination rates under different data regimes.
Apply federated and privacy-preserving learning frameworks to enable high-quality data usage in privacy-sensitive domains like healthcare and law.
Explore socio-ethical governance models covering data ethics, sourcing transparency, and model behavior explainability.
